newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Escorts ties up with Carraro.
newsitem.headline: India's Escorts ties up with Carraro.

text.p: India's Escorts Ltd on Thursday signed an agreement with Italy's Carraro to manufacture tramsmissions, axles and gears in the country, a company statement said.
The memorandum of understanding (MOU) was signed between Rajan Nanda, chairman of Escorts Ltd and and M. Carraro, managing director of Carraro Spa.
Carraro will hold 51 percent of the equity stake in the joint venture which will be named Carraro India Ltd, while Escorts will hold the rest, the statement said.
It said the products are expected to roll out from the new facility to be shortly set up in India, within 20 months.
The Carraro group in Italy manufactures a wide range of auto equipment. It exports 85 percent of its products, manufactured in Italy, to Europe and the U.S.
"Carraro India will become a major source facility from where we can supply components to our world-wide customer base," the statement quoted Carraro as saying.
"Our projections forecast an export of 8,000 transmissions, axles and assemblies in the very first year of production here."
